comment: Haskell type definition names, like `Hash` in `data Hash = ...`, `Salt` in `newtype Salt = ...` or `Hashable` in `class (Eq a) => Hashable a`. The builtin grammar uses the same `storage.type.haskell` scope for defined names and type usages, and the language server sends the same semantic token for both, so only these names get `entity.name.type.haskell`. Type usages, `instance` heads, and `type` synonyms stay uncolored.

patterns.comment: `class Name`, `class Ctx a => Name` and `class (Ctx a, Ctx b) => Name`
